title: Erdős 249 lcm-cone completeness: affine half-geometric decay

concepts.label: affine half-geometric decay
concepts.note: The sequences j·2^-j and (C+j)·2^-j are summable, hence the latter tends to zero.

concepts.label: certificate-completeness analytic boundary
concepts.note: The decay lemmas provide only the analytic small-error input consumed by finite certificate completeness.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED ANALYTIC TOOLKIT: the sequence j·(1/2)^j is summable, and for every real constant C the affine sequence (C+j)·(1/2)^j is summable as the sum of a geometric constant term and the linear term.
statement_nodes.engine: Specialize the standard polynomial-times-geometric summability theorem at ratio one half and add a constant multiple of the geometric series.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Classical convergence of polynomially weighted geometric series, restated at the exact ratio used by the lcm-cone certificate proof.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The lemmas show decay of an affine error envelope only. They do not prove tail nonintegrality, produce a certified kill without that hypothesis, establish cone supply, or imply irrationality on their own.
